description: PAID $0.0009 USDC. For one Base address: latest USDC transfers newest first (read from Base RPC logs, minutes fresh) with tx hash, block and time, and flags for lookalike senders/recipients that copy the first and last hex characters of a real counterparty (zero-value transferFrom spoofs, dust sends). Use before copying an address from wallet history. Returns JSON of recent Base USDC transfers for the address, newest first, with tx hash, block, time, and lookalike flags.

address.description: Base address to inspect. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0xc9d9a973d9817d482a47dfc118cf78436e5cffcb. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

hours.description: Look-back window in hours. Format: a number from 0.25 to 24. Example: 6. Default: 6, as the existing tool text states.

name: address_poisoning
